title: Show Text Selection Context Menu
description: When text is selected in the UI, show the text context menu (copy to clipboard, cut, paste, select all) with platform shortcuts such as Ctrl+C / ⌘️C. Native browser menus are globally suppressed, so selected selectable text currently has no copy affordance on right-click.
summary: Added a global TextSelectionContextMenuHost so right-clicking a DOM text selection opens Cut/Copy/Paste/Select all with platform shortcuts (⌘️C / Ctrl+C). Mounted in the OS shell and Storybook surface host. Native menus stay suppressed. Also fixed ui-styling/ui-react package exports to local paths so vitest resolves workspace packages. ContextMenu vitest: 16 passed.
